title: MagneticOracle v1 — full 12-feature × 6-output acceptance diagnostics
scope: Fast pipeline diagnostic only; 4 seconds, 15 iterations, 3-event subset per iteration. Not full-render or musical-quality validation.

diagnosis.interpretation: On this rebuilt checkpoint, output_4 is positively correlated with spectral centroid (+0.139), not negatively correlated as in the earlier report (-0.573). Its strongest render-trajectory associations are mean (-0.923), RMS (-0.914), and standard deviation (-0.914). In the training set, output_4 tracks its centroid-derived target at r=0.574 and is only weakly correlated with mean (+0.066) and RMS (+0.155). This does not support a learned mean/RMS proxy in the training distribution; it points more strongly to deployment-trajectory covariation and feature-distribution shift. Centroid range overlaps but render mean/std, ZCR, flux, and FFT-bin distributions differ materially. The earlier -0.573 result was not reproduced by the deterministic checkpoint rebuild; preserve it as a prior-run observation, not as the current checkpoint result. No target remapping is made in this diagnostic pass.
